format: single F45 Studio (approx. 1,650 to 3,000 sq ft leased)

invest.quote: The total investment necessary to begin operation of an F45 Studio is between $362,300 to $857,700.  This includes $299,600 to $373,200 that must be paid to the franchisor or its affiliates.

fee.quote: On the Effective Date of the Franchise Agreement, you must pay us: (i) a $60,000 establishment fee; and (ii) up to a $2,500 document preparation fee
fee.note: Called an 'establishment fee'; plus up to $2,500 document preparation fee. Up to 25% discount for certain approved US military veterans. $60,000 per additional Studio committed. In 2025 establishment fees collected ranged from $30,000 to $60,000. Equipment Pack of $115,000 must be bought from the franchisor or affiliate.

royalty.flat: The greater of 7% of Gross Sales or $2,500 per month
royalty.quote: Royalty Fee The greater of 7% of Gross Sales(2) or $2,500 per month $2,500 is due on the Opening Date and then in advance on the first day of each calendar month thereafter.

adFund.quote: Brand Fund Up to 2% of Gross Sales, or $200 per month, whichever is higher
adFund.note: Brand Fund up to 2% of Gross Sales or $200/month, whichever is higher; plus a Marketing Fee of $2,500 per month paid to the franchisor for local advertising (or $2,500/month local spend if not paid directly). Grand opening minimum $25,000.

otherRecurring.name: Minimum royalty
otherRecurring.amount: $2,500 per month (royalty is the greater of 7% of Gross Sales or $2,500 per month)

otherRecurring.name: Merchandise for Resale (minimum purchase)
otherRecurring.amount: Currently, not less than $1,500 every three months (does not include shipping, taxes, and duties)

otherRecurring.name: LionHeart Bands
otherRecurring.amount: Currently, $54 per monitor; at least 100 monitors every year after the first 12 months

otherRecurring.name: Annual Conference
otherRecurring.amount: $600 per ticket; a minimum of two tickets must be purchased

transferFee.amount: 25% of the then-current establishment fee, plus our reasonable costs and expenses associated with the transfer, including training costs and legal and accounting fees

item19.note: Gross Sales only; does not reflect cost of sales, operating expenses, real estate, lease or occupancy cost. 279 (41.3%) above average. 22 of 698 US franchised studios excluded (not open the full period). Data from POS reports, not audited.

special: Royalty has a $2,500 monthly minimum and the Marketing Fee is a fixed $2,500 per month, so fixed fees to the franchisor are at least $5,000/month plus $500 technology fee and the Brand Fund minimum of $200. Most of the initial investment ($299,600 to $373,200) is paid to the franchisor or affiliates, including the $115,000 Equipment Pack. Mandatory merchandise purchases ($1,500 per quarter, 100 LionHeart monitors per year). If Gross Sales fall below 70% of the system average, franchisor may impose promotional programs costing up to the monthly royalty.
issues: Item 20 Table 1 as printed does not add up for 2025 (707 franchised + 2 company = 709, printed total 708). Transfer fee usd computed as 25% of the $60,000 establishment fee, before costs. Item 7 total also covers optional Recovery Amenities per note 21.
